title: DOOH Delivery Metrics
description: Delivery metrics specific to digital out-of-home (DOOH) campaigns, such as loop plays, screens used, screen time, and share of voice.

loop_plays.description: Number of times ad played in rotation

screens_used.description: Number of unique screens displaying the ad

sov_achieved.description: Actual share of voice delivered on a 0.0-1.0 scale. To compare this achieved value with the selected flat-rate DOOH parameters.sov_percentage, multiply sov_achieved by 100. Share is time-weighted: the sum of the delivered segment durations divided by the full loop duration. On equal-duration loops this equals the slot-count ratio. See also ooh_metrics.share_of_voice_contracted, which uses the same 0.0-1.0 scale.

calculation_notes.description: Per-row supplementary methodology notes for DOOH impression calculation (e.g., 'rotation-based; 6-second slot weighted by 70% audience overlap'). Free-form prose for context that doesn't fit the structured measurement-vendor surface. Canonical methodology declarations belong on the measurement vendor's `get_adcp_capabilities.measurement.metrics[]` block where they're discoverable once and inherited across delivery rows; this field is for row-specific context (a particular daypart's calculation, a venue-mix exception) rather than the seller's general methodology.

impression_basis.description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). Methodology tier of the row's `impressions` when every play in the row was estimated on that tier. SHOULD be present whenever a DOOH row reports `impressions`. When the row's plays were estimated on different tiers, sellers MUST omit it, never substituting `hybrid` or the majority tier, and report `impression_basis_breakdown`; a row never carries both. A buyer filtering on this field therefore misses mixed rows and has to read the breakdown. Sellers that emit it MUST list `media_buy.dooh_impression_basis` in `experimental_features`.

audience_multiplier.description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). The row's `impressions / plays`, rounded, so a buyer can compare rows. `impressions` is authoritative: a receiver MUST NOT reject a multiplier that differs from `impressions / plays` only by rounding. On `sensor_measured` and `hybrid` rows sellers SHOULD include it, and it is the realised ratio for the period, which varies by row. On `currency_measured` rows it is optional. A row that reports `impression_basis_breakdown` SHOULD omit it and give each entry's multiplier instead: a multiplier blended across tiers mixes different units and misleads.

basis_metric.description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). On rows whose impressions are, wholly or through an `impression_basis_breakdown` entry, `sensor_measured` or `hybrid`, the `vendor_metric_values[]` row the sensor audience derives from, joined on `(vendor, metric_id, qualifier)`. That row carries the coverage (`measurable_plays`) and the seller–vendor relationship, and the vendor catalog the methodology. When `basis_metric` is present, a matching row MUST be present in the `vendor_metric_values[]` of the delivery row that carries this `dooh_metrics`. Totals and package rows MAY omit it when the rows below them carry it.

impression_basis_breakdown.description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). For a row that aggregates plays estimated on different tiers — a product mixing sensor-equipped screens and screens without a sensor, or a sensor-equipped screen whose fallback plays, estimated while its sensor was not reporting, are `seller_modeled` — one entry per tier present: at least two entries, whose tiers MUST be distinct and whose `plays` and `impressions` MUST sum exactly to the row's. Each entry of a parent row (totals, a package) MUST equal the sum of its child rows' entries for that tier, a single-tier child counting as one entry. A row never carries both this and `impression_basis`. Tiers are different units with no exchange rate, so compare impressions within a tier (and for `sensor_measured`, within the same `basis_metric`), and plays and spend across tiers. Billing is unchanged: a CPM bills the row's total `impressions`, all tiers together. Sellers that emit it MUST list `media_buy.dooh_impression_basis` in `experimental_features`.

screens_used.description: Number of screens used at this venue

impression_basis.description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). Methodology tier of this venue's impressions, when it differs across venues of the row. Sellers MUST omit it on a venue whose plays were estimated on different tiers.

plays.description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). Plays at this venue, counted like the delivery row's `plays`: raw plays before any impression multiplier, not `loop_plays`. Each screen that played the spot counts one play, so a spot shown at once on three synchronized screens is three plays. A venue row carries no multiplier; its audience per play is `impressions / plays`.
